prompt: You recently had a call with a new client about a business proposal. You want to follow up not just to ask for missing information (like expected delivery time), but also to ask if any documents or samples are available to better understand their expectations. Your email should include: * Reference to the call * A question about delivery timeline * A request for supporting materials (documents/samples) * A professional tone and closing
response:
Subject: Follow-up regarding our recent proposal discussion

Dear Client,

Thank you for the productive call earlier today to discuss our business proposal. I am excited about the potential partnership. 

To ensure our planning remains accurate, could you please confirm your expected delivery timeline? Additionally, if you have any relevant project documents or product samples available for review, please share them with me. These materials will help us better align our strategy with your expectations.

I look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Bhuvana
